What the words mean

  • running: the agent in a busy slot reported a step within the last 30 minutes (worktrees.stalledAfterMinutes).
  • stalled: no report for more than 30 minutes. The session may have ended, crashed or been abandoned, or one step runs long; a slot whose run is over (step done) and that waits for its merge shows it too. Look at it: nothing is stopped or freed.
  • unknown: a busy slot without a report (taken by hand or by an older version), or a value this page could not read. It is never taken as free or done.
  • free: no agent works in the slot.
  • stale: ...: flagged as /status flags it: a busy slot whose pull request merged or closed, or that has none after 2 hours.
